title: FieldOps — The right moment

format.delivery: MP4 H.264 + AAC, captions plus SRT, transcript

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: An orchard can look healthy while the next harvest is already at risk. The difference is catching the right signal—and acting on it in time.
segments.visual: Cinematic orchard aerial, camera moving between natural grassy rows; drone reveal. FieldOps title arrives over footage.
segments.label: Drone concept visualization

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Meet FieldOps: orchard intelligence on a Dell Pro Max with GB10. Our vision starts with a drone collecting visual samples: photographs of farm regions, connected to insect observations from sticky traps.
segments.visual: Drone gimbal photographs two orchard regions; subtle capture brackets. Match cut into actual 3D farm and Start drone survey.
segments.label: Concept visualization → Simulated survey

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Here, the simulated survey covers six growing blocks. Rotate the farm, follow the flight, and open each virtual capture. The dashboard connects the landscape to eighteen traps and the season underneath.
segments.visual: Real 3D orbit, Follow drone, capture sweep, Review captures, select Block C. Compress the 24-second simulation through purposeful cuts.
segments.label: Demo season · Simulated survey

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: On June fourth, Block C stands out in red. Its traps recorded twenty-six codling moths. Its biological clock has reached two hundred sixty-one degree-days—inside the configured treatment window.
segments.visual: Overview danger count → visible red Block C → 26 trap count and 261 DD → Weather & timing 250–350 DD window. Hold the key figures.
segments.label: Committed demo season · June 4

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Follow the evidence: labeled trap images, pest activity, and temperature history. Biofix starts the clock. Deterministic code determines the window. The counting is impressive. The decision is what matters.
segments.visual: Trap lab with synthetic reference badge; Pest analytics flight curve and heatmap; Window planner. Use close framing so chart labels remain legible.
segments.label: Sample trap image · Demo season

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Ask why. The assistant explains the season facts, with speech generated locally on the GB10.
segments.visual: Open Talk to FieldOps, Type instead, enter Why is Block C in danger?, return to voice and click Hear answer. Keep the actual input method visible.
segments.label: Local speech · Season facts

segments.speaker: FieldOps / live GB10 Kokoro
segments.text: Block C: Spray window open. The authoritative timeline records biofix on May 8. Block C has 261.0 degree-days since that recorded start.
segments.visual: Actual speaking orb and answer over the movable farm; no narrator or music competing with the reply.
segments.source: actual dashboard and GB10 audio; exact UI reply
segments.label: GB10-generated speech

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Here is the real Telegram workflow. Send a trap photo; FieldOps returns species counts, a marked-up image, and the block status. The next action reaches the grower.
segments.visual: Use pitch/assets/telegram-trap-count.webp. Show submitted photo, then pan to actual boxes and 27 codling / 7 oriental fruit moth counts. Keep this labeled as a separate live photo example. A small simulated June 4 window-alert card may close the shot, explicitly labeled; never change the real screenshot numbers.
segments.source: real supplied Telegram screenshot; optional window-alert card is simulated
segments.label: Live photo example · separate from season replay

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: NemoClaw, OpenClaw, and OpenShell support the local agent workflow. Inference and decisions stay on the farm; Telegram delivers the message.
segments.visual: Simple architecture overlay: photo → GB10 / YOLO + decision engine + local agent → dashboard / phone. Return to farm hero.
segments.label: Local inference · Telegram requires connectivity

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: FieldOps. Count the moths. Start the clock. Act at the right moment.
segments.visual: Bold FieldOps lockup over farm, red Block C slowly recedes; end card holds cleanly.
